data: What is the approximate value of the blue line at the end of the x-axis?

Wait a moment, let me look at the graph carefully. The blue line represents the statistics of "FinTech" in Google Trends. At the end of the x-axis, which appears to be November 2019, I can see the blue line reaching approximately 95 on the y-axis.
Therefore, the approximate value of the blue line at the end of the x-axis is 95.
The answer is 95.
